title: Lakshmana's angry words
introduction: This chapter describes the valiant words of Lakshmana, his opposing depends on god and proposes to fight with Rama's enemies to endow Rama with Kingdom.
closing: || इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रयोविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes twenty third chapter of Ayodhya Kanda in Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
इति ब्रुवति रामे तु लक्ष्मणो अधः शिरा मुहुः |
श्रुत्वा मध्यम् जगाम इव मनसा दुह्ख हर्षयोह्
verses.iast:
iti bruvati rāme tu lakṣmaṇo adhaḥ śirā muhuḥ |
śrutvā madhyam jagāma iva manasā duhkha harṣayoh
verses.translation: While Rama was thus speeding, Lakshmana heard, bowed down his head and got into the midst of pain and pleasure effecting his mind again and again.

verses.devanagari:
तदा तु बद्ध्वा भ्रुकुटीम् भ्रुवोर् मध्ये नर ऋषभ |
निशश्वास महा सर्पो बिलस्यैव रोषितः
verses.iast:
tadā tu baddhvā bhrukuṭīm bhruvor madhye nara ṛṣabha |
niśaśvāsa mahā sarpo bilasyaiva roṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Lakshmana then firmed up his eyebrows and sighed with frown, like an angry snake from its hole.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य दुष्प्रतिवीक्ष्यम् तत् भ्रुकुटी सहितम् तदा |
बभौ क्रुद्धस्य सिम्हस्य मुखस्य सदृशम् मुखम्
verses.iast:
tasya duṣprativīkṣyam tat bhrukuṭī sahitam tadā |
babhau kruddhasya simhasya mukhasya sadṛśam mukham
verses.translation: His wickedly looking face with eyebrows contracted, then appeared like the face of an angry lion.

verses.devanagari:
अग्रहः तम् विधुन्वंस् तु हस्ती हस्तम् इवात्मनः |
तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वम् शरीरे च पातयित्वा शिरः धराम्
अग्र अक्ष्णा वीक्षमाणः तु तिर्यग् भ्रातरम् अब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
agrahaḥ tam vidhunvaṃs tu hastī hastam ivātmanaḥ |
tiryag ūrdhvam śarīre ca pātayitvā śiraḥ dharām
agra akṣṇā vīkṣamāṇaḥ tu tiryag bhrātaram abravīt |
verses.translation: Seeing Rama with the tip of his eyes obliquely, Lakshmana spoke to him moving his forehand like an elephant moving its trunk and causing his head to fall in oblique and upward direction.

verses.devanagari:
अस्थाने सम्भ्रमः यस्य जातः वै सुमहान् अयम्
धर्म दोष प्रसन्गेन लोकस्य अनतिशन्कया |
कथम् हि एतत् असम्भ्रान्तः त्वद् विधो वक्तुम् अर्हति
यथा दैवम् अशौण्डीरम् शौण्डीरः क्षत्रिय ऋषभः |
verses.iast:
asthāne sambhramaḥ yasya jātaḥ vai sumahān ayam
dharma doṣa prasangena lokasya anatiśankayā |
katham hi etat asambhrāntaḥ tvad vidho vaktum arhati
yathā daivam aśauṇḍīram śauṇḍīraḥ kṣatriya ṛṣabhaḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, the best of proud military community! This untimely great confusion is born in you due to your conjecture of quilty righteousness and of non suspicion of the world. Can such a person like you speak a person like you speak thus doubtlessly of the powerless destiny?"

glosses.itrans: the best of proud military community! ayam
glosses.iast: the best of proud military community! ayam
glosses.devanagari: थे बेस्त् ओf प्रोउद् मिलितर्य् चोम्मुनित्य्! अयं

verses.devanagari:
किम् नाम कृपणम् दैवम् अशक्तम् अभिशंसति |
पापयोस् तु कथम् नाम तयोह् शन्का न विद्यते
verses.iast:
kim nāma kṛpaṇam daivam aśaktam abhiśaṃsati |
pāpayos tu katham nāma tayoh śankā na vidyate
verses.translation: "Why are you speaking about this weak and pitiable destiny? Why are you not doubting the sinful Kaikeyi and Dasaratha?"

glosses.meaning: which is weak? katham naama = how

verses.devanagari:
सन्ति धर्म उपधाः श्लक्ष्णा धर्मात्मन् किम् न बुध्यसे
तयोस्सुचरितम् स्वार्थम् शाठ्यात् परिजिहीर्षतोः |
verses.iast:
santi dharma upadhāḥ ślakṣṇā dharmātman kim na budhyase
tayossucaritam svārtham śāṭhyāt parijihīrśhatoḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, the righteous sould! Both of them are smoothly deceiving in the name of righteousness with an intent to keep away your good conduct, with selfish away your good conduct, with selfish motive and by dishonest means. You are not knowing."

verses.devanagari:
यदि नैवम् व्यवसितम् स्याद्धि प्राग्रेव राघव |
तयोः प्रागेव दत्तश्च स्याद्वरः प्रकृतश्च सः
verses.iast:
yadi naivam vyavasitam syāddhi prāgreva rāghava |
tayoḥ prāgeva dattaśca syādvaraḥ prakṛtaśca saḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! If it was not indeed an earlier decision taken long ago by both of them, the boon must have been given naturally even long ago."

glosses.meaning: if it was not vyavasitam = decision

verses.devanagari:
लोक विद्विष्टम् आरब्धम् त्वद् अन्यस्य अभिषेचनम् |
नोत्सहे सहितुम् वीर तत्र मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
loka vidviṣṭam ārabdham tvad anyasya abhiṣecanam |
notsahe sahitum vīra tatra me kśantumarhasi
verses.translation: "Enthroning other than yourself is not to the liking of the people. I cannot tolerate this act that is started. Excuse me in this matter."

glosses.meaning: is not to the liking of people

verses.devanagari:
येन इयम् आगता द्वैधम् तव बुद्धिर् मही पते |
स हि धर्मः मम द्वेष्यः प्रसन्गात् यस्य मुह्यसि
verses.iast:
yena iyam āgatā dvaidham tava buddhir mahī pate |
sa hi dharmaḥ mama dveṣyaḥ prasangāt yasya muhyasi
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama the great minded! This righteousness by which your intellect got disunited and by which indulgence, you are stupefied, is disliked by me."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् त्वम् कर्मणा शक्तः कैकेयीवशवर्तिनः |
करिष्यसि पितुर्वाक्यमधर्मिष्ठम् विगर्हितम्
verses.iast:
katham tvam karmaṇā śaktaḥ kaikeyīvaśavartinaḥ |
kariśhyasi piturvākyamadharmiśhṭham vigarhitam
verses.translation: "you are capable of doing retaliatory action. How can you act on the word which is reprehensible and which is unjustified of your father who is surrendering obediently to the will of Kaikeyi?"

verses.devanagari:
यद्य् अपि प्रतिपत्तिस् ते दैवी च अपि तयोः मतम् |
तथा अपि उपेक्षणीयम् ते न मे तत् अपि रोचते
verses.iast:
yady api pratipattis te daivī ca api tayoḥ matam |
tathā api upekṣaṇīyam te na me tat api rocate
verses.translation: "Though they are doing this treachery with a sinful intent, I regret that you are not grasping it. Such a conduct is to be censured."

verses.devanagari:
मन्साऽपि कथम् कामम् कुर्यास्त्वम् कामवृत्तयोः |
तयोस्त्वहितयोर्नित्यम् शत्र्वोः पित्रभिधानयोः
verses.iast:
mansā'pi katham kāmam kuryāstvam kāmavṛttayoḥ |
tayostvahitayornityam śatrvoḥ pitrabhidhānayoḥ
verses.translation: "But of them, action on their own free will, were never desirous of your welfare. They are enemies in the name of parents. It is not proper even to think of fulfilling their desire."

glosses.meaning: who are action on their own free will
who were not desirous of your welfare

verses.devanagari:
यद्यपि प्रतिपत्तिस्ते दैवी चापि तयोर्मतम् |
तथा प्युपेक्षणीयम् ते न मे तदपि रोचते
verses.iast:
yadyapi pratipattiste daivī cāpi tayormatam |
tathā pyupekśaṇīyam te na me tadapi rocate
verses.translation: "It may be your opinion that their action is influenced by mere destiny. Even then, I do not like you to be indifferent to this also."

glosses.meaning: is indeed caused by divine power

verses.devanagari:
विक्लवो वीर्य हीनो यः स दैवम् अनुवर्तते |
वीराः सम्भावित आत्मानो न दैवम् पर्युपासते
verses.iast:
viklavo vīrya hīno yaḥ sa daivam anuvartate |
vīrāḥ sambhāvita ātmāno na daivam paryupāsate
verses.translation: "Only a confused and cowardly person depends upon destiny. Brave men with self-respect do not honour the destiny."

glosses.meaning: with self respect naparyupaasate = do not honour

verses.devanagari:
दैवम् पुरुष कारेण यः समर्थः प्रबाधितुम् |
न दैवेन विपन्न अर्थः पुरुषः सो अवसीदति
verses.iast:
daivam puruṣa kāreṇa yaḥ samarthaḥ prabādhitum |
na daivena vipanna arthaḥ puruṣaḥ so avasīdati
verses.translation: "That person who is capable of keeping off destiny by human effort, does not have regret in the sense of not being failed by destiny."

glosses.meaning: in the sense of not being failed

verses.devanagari:
द्रक्ष्यन्ति तु अद्य दैवस्य पौरुषम् पुरुषस्य च |
दैव मानुषयोः अद्य व्यक्ता व्यक्तिर् भविष्यति
verses.iast:
drakṣyanti tu adya daivasya pauruṣam puruṣasya ca |
daiva mānuṣayoḥ adya vyaktā vyaktir bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "Today, all can see how much prowess is there in destiny and in man. This day, the distinction between man and the destiny will be clearly perceived."

glosses.meaning: between man and destiny bhavishhyati = will become

verses.devanagari:
अद्य मत् पौरुष हतम् दैवम् द्रक्ष्यन्ति वै जनाः |
यद् दैवात् आहतम् ते अद्य द्ऱ्ष्टम् राज्य अभिषेचनम्
verses.iast:
adya mat pauruṣa hatam daivam drakṣyanti vai janāḥ |
yad daivāt āhatam te adya dRṣṭam rājya abhiṣecanam
verses.translation: "By which destiny, your coronation is seen crushed, I shall crush that destiny by my prowess. Let all people see it!"

verses.devanagari:
अत्यन्कुशम् इव उद्दामम् गजम् मद बल उद्धतम् |
प्रधावितम् अहम् दैवम् पौरुषेण निवर्तये
verses.iast:
atyankuśam iva uddāmam gajam mada bala uddhatam |
pradhāvitam aham daivam pauruṣeṇa nivartaye
verses.translation: "By my prowess, I shall turn back this destiny, as framing back an elephant which is not caring a hook and which is fiercely running with violent force."

glosses.meaning: which is not caring a hook

verses.devanagari:
लोक पालाः समस्ताः ते न अद्य राम अभिषेचनम् |
न च क्ऱ्त्स्नाः त्रयो लोका विहन्युः किम् पुनः पिता
verses.iast:
loka pālāḥ samastāḥ te na adya rāma abhiṣecanam |
na ca kRtsnāḥ trayo lokā vihanyuḥ kim punaḥ pitā
verses.translation: "Neither all the guardians of the world nor the three worlds put together can withhold Rama's coronation today. Why to talk about father."

verses.devanagari:
यैः विवासः तव अरण्ये मिथो राजन् समर्थितः |
अरण्ये तु विवत्स्यन्ति चतुर् दश समाः तथा
verses.iast:
yaiḥ vivāsaḥ tava araṇye mitho rājan samarthitaḥ |
araṇye tu vivatsyanti catur daśa samāḥ tathā
verses.translation: "Oh, King! Those who are secritlyadvocating you to live in a forest for fourteen years, will have to reside in forest for fourteen years in that manner."

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तदा आशाम् चेत्स्यामि पितुस् तस्याः च या तव |
अभिषेक विघातेन पुत्र राज्याय वर्तते
verses.iast:
aham tadā āśām cetsyāmi pitus tasyāḥ ca yā tava |
abhiṣeka vighātena putra rājyāya vartate
verses.translation: "That is why, I shall break down the hope of father and of Kaikeyi, who is trying for kingdom to her son by creating obstacle to your coronation."

glosses.meaning: by creting obstacle to your coronation.

verses.devanagari:
मद् बलेन विरुद्धाय न स्यात् दैव बलम् तथा |
प्रभविष्यति दुह्खाय यथा उग्रम् पौरुषम् मम
verses.iast:
mad balena viruddhāya na syāt daiva balam tathā |
prabhaviṣyati duhkhāya yathā ugram pauruṣam mama
verses.translation: "The strength of destiny cannot create that much pain as that which my terrific prowess will create to those who are opposed to my strength."

glosses.meaning: to those who are opposed to

verses.devanagari:
ऊर्ध्वम् वर्ष सहस्र अन्ते प्रजा पाल्यम् अनन्तरम् |
आर्य पुत्राः करिष्यन्ति वन वासम् गते त्वयि
verses.iast:
ūrdhvam varṣa sahasra ante prajā pālyam anantaram |
ārya putrāḥ kariṣyanti vana vāsam gate tvayi
verses.translation: "At the end of a thousand years of your ruling the kingdom, you having gone to the forest, your sons will govern the kingdom."

glosses.meaning: at the end of thousand years

verses.devanagari:
पूर्व राज ऱ्षि व्ऱ्त्त्या हि वन वासो विधीयते |
प्रजा निक्षिप्य पुत्रेषु पुत्रवत् परिपालने
verses.iast:
pūrva rāja Rṣi vRttyā hi vana vāso vidhīyate |
prajā nikṣipya putreṣu putravat paripālane
verses.translation: "It is indeed a practice for ancient kings to go to the forest after keeping care of people, to be nourished as children, into the hands of their sons."

verses.devanagari:
स चेद् राजनि अनेक अग्रे राज्य विभ्रम शन्कया |
न एवम् इच्चसि धर्मात्मन् राज्यम् राम त्वम् आत्मनि
प्रतिजाने च ते वीर मा भूवम् वीर लोक भाक् |
राज्यम् च तव रक्षेयम् अहम् वेला इव सागरम्
verses.iast:
sa ced rājani aneka agre rājya vibhrama śankayā |
na evam iccasi dharmātman rājyam rāma tvam ātmani
pratijāne ca te vīra mā bhūvam vīra loka bhāk |
rājyam ca tava rakṣeyam aham velā iva sāgaram
verses.translation: "If you think that you do not want kingdom because of your doubt that the kingdom will get disturbed due to unstable mind of king Dasaratha, you need not fear. I am promising you. I shall protect the kingdom as a sea coast protects the sea. If not, I will not obtain the heroic world of heaven."

glosses.meaning: the one who gets heroic world of heaven

verses.devanagari:
मन्गलैः अभिषिन्चस्व तत्र त्वम् व्याप्ऱ्तः भव |
अहम् एको मही पालान् अलम् वारयितुम् बलात्
verses.iast:
mangalaiḥ abhiṣincasva tatra tvam vyāpRtaḥ bhava |
aham eko mahī pālān alam vārayitum balāt
verses.translation: "You become engaged in getting coronated with auspicious things. I for one is competent to ward off the kings by force."

verses.devanagari:
न शोभ अर्थाव् इमौ बाहू न धनुर् भूषणाय मे |
न असिरा बन्धन अर्थाय न शराः स्तम्भ हेतवः
अमित्र दमन अर्थम् मे सर्वम् एतच् चतुष्टयम् |
verses.iast:
na śobha arthāv imau bāhū na dhanur bhūṣaṇāya me |
na asirā bandhana arthāya na śarāḥ stambha hetavaḥ
amitra damana artham me sarvam etac catuṣṭayam |
verses.translation: "My arms are not meant for handsomeness alone. Bow is not for decoration. Sword is not for tying around waist. Arrows are not for staying immobile. All these four are intended for subduing enemies."

verses.devanagari:
न च अहम् कामये अत्यर्थम् यः स्यात् शत्रुर् मतः मम
असिना तीक्ष्ण धारेण विद्युच् चलित वर्चसा |
प्रग्ऱ्हीतेन वै शत्रुम् वज्रिणम् वा न कल्पये
verses.iast:
na ca aham kāmaye atyartham yaḥ syāt śatrur mataḥ mama
asinā tīkṣṇa dhāreṇa vidyuc calita varcasā |
pragRhītena vai śatrum vajriṇam vā na kalpaye
verses.translation: "I do not wish to tolerate too much the one who is considered as enemy to me. By wearing a sword with sharp edge which is mavingly bright like lightening, I do not care any enemy, even Indra himself. This earth will become impermeable, uninhabited with heads hands and thighs of elephants horses and men crushed, having been hit by my sword."

glosses.meaning: having moving brilliance like lightening. mahii = this earth
with hands thighs and heads of elephants horses and men
crushed having been struck by my sword.

verses.devanagari:
खड्ग निष्पेष निष्पिष्टैः गहना दुश्चरा च मे |
हस्ति अश्व नर हस्त ऊरु शिरोभिर् भविता मही
verses.iast:
khaḍga niṣpeṣa niṣpiṣṭaiḥ gahanā duścarā ca me |
hasti aśva nara hasta ūru śirobhir bhavitā mahī
verses.translation: "Now, elephants can fall down on earth, being hit by the gush of my sword, like mountains in blaze, like clouds, savidyutaH = with flashes of lightening.

glosses.meaning: being hit by the gush of my sword

verses.devanagari:
खड्ग धारा हता मे अद्य दीप्यमानाइव अद्रयः |
पतिष्यन्ति द्विपा भूमौ मेघाइव सविद्युतः
verses.iast:
khaḍga dhārā hatā me adya dīpyamānāiva adrayaḥ |
patiṣyanti dvipā bhūmau meghāiva savidyutaḥ
verses.translation: "As I stand holding a bow with fingers wound with shields made of allegator-skin, how any man will fancy himself a hero among men?"

glosses.meaning: with fingers wound with sheathing made of alligator skin

verses.devanagari:
बद्ध गोधा अन्गुलि त्राणे प्रगृहीत शर आसने |
कथम् पुरुष मानी स्यात् पुरुषाणाम् मयि स्थिते
verses.iast:
baddha godhā anguli trāṇe pragṛhīta śara āsane |
katham puruṣa mānī syāt puruṣāṇām mayi sthite
verses.translation: "While I overpower one with many arrows and many with a single arrow, I discharge my arrows at vitals of men, horses and elephants."

verses.devanagari:
बहुभिः च एकम् अत्यस्यन्न् एकेन च बहून् जनान् |
विनियोक्ष्याम्य् अहम् बाणान् नृ वाजि गज मर्मसु
verses.iast:
bahubhiḥ ca ekam atyasyann ekena ca bahūn janān |
viniyokṣyāmy aham bāṇān nṛ vāji gaja marmasu
verses.translation: "Oh, Lord! Today, the strength of my excellent arrows is capable of making you sovereign and making Dasaratha devoid of power."

glosses.meaning: the supreme power and raajJNyaH = to king Dasaratha

verses.devanagari:
अद्य मे अस्त्र प्रभावस्य प्रभावः प्रभविष्यति |
राज्ञः च अप्रभुताम् कर्तुम् प्रभुत्वम् च तव प्रभो
verses.iast:
adya me astra prabhāvasya prabhāvaḥ prabhaviṣyati |
rāGYaḥ ca aprabhutām kartum prabhutvam ca tava prabho
verses.translation: " Oh, Lord Rama! Today the effect of my weapons will remove the power from the king Dasaratha and give the lordship to you."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य चन्दन सारस्य केयूरा मोक्षणस्य च |
वसूनाम् च विमोक्षस्य सुह्ऱ्दाम् पालनस्य च
अनुरूपाव् इमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः |
अभिषेचन विघ्नस्य कर्तृउणाम् ते निवारणे
verses.iast:
adya candana sārasya keyūrā mokṣaṇasya ca |
vasūnām ca vimokṣasya suhRdām pālanasya ca
anurūpāv imau bāhū rāma karma kariṣyataḥ |
abhiṣecana vighnasya kartṛuṇām te nivāraṇe
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! These arms worthy of wearing sandalwood essence and bracelets; for bestowing riches and for protection of friends can today do every action to prevent the agents who want to obstruct your coronation."

verses.devanagari:
ब्रवीहि को अद्य एव मया वियुज्यताम् |
तव असुह्ऱ्द् प्राण यशः सुह्ऱ्ज् जनैः |
यथा तव इयम् वसुधा वशे भवेत् |
तथा एव माम् शाधि तव अस्मि किम्करः
verses.iast:
bravīhi ko adya eva mayā viyujyatām |
tava asuhRd prāṇa yaśaḥ suhRj janaiḥ |
yathā tava iyam vasudhā vaśe bhavet |
tathā eva mām śādhi tava asmi kimkaraḥ
verses.translation: "Tell me now itself who your enemy be made deprived of life, honour and friendship, by me. Command me so that how this earth will become your dominion. I am your servant.

verses.devanagari:
विम्ऱ्ज्य बाष्पम् परिसान्त्व्य च असकृत् |
स लक्ष्मणम् राघव वंश वर्धनः |
उवाच पित्र्ये वचने व्यवस्थितम् |
निबोध माम् एष हि सौम्य सत् पथः
verses.iast:
vimRjya bāṣpam parisāntvya ca asakṛt |
sa lakṣmaṇam rāghava vaṃśa vardhanaḥ |
uvāca pitrye vacane vyavasthitam |
nibodha mām eṣa hi saumya sat pathaḥ
verses.translation: Then, Rama spoke thus to Lakshmana after consoling him time and again by weeping off his tears; "Oh, Lakshmana! I stand by the words of our father. This indeed is a good path."
